This appointments system was created several years ago as patients were typically having to wait more than 3 weeks to be seen. We try to strike a balance between having enough appointments available for patients who need a consultation as soon as possible and those who can wait a few days. It is very fine balance as we have found that when we have tried to reduce the number of same day appointments and offer more pre-bookable appointments, more patients were having to be directed to the Minor Injuries Unit, to the Walk-In Centre in Shrewsbury or to Accident \u0026 Emergency Departments.\nWe try to do our very best with the resources that are provided to us by the NHS.
